_note: Fictional sample data. Firm, client, people and numbers are invented to show the flow. The agent reads every timesheet note; the demo shows 21 representative notes. hoursToDate is the phase total from all timesheets.

project.name: Riverside Clinic Expansion
project.contract: Lump-sum fee by phase, AIA B101-style agreement

scope.text: Schematic design: up to two design options, with one round of client revisions before SD sign-off.
Design development and construction documents for a two-storey, approximately 12,000 sq ft addition housing 14 exam rooms, a pharmacy and staff areas, per the program dated 3 March 2026.
Up to six client meetings during design development and four during construction documents.
Coordination of structural and MEP consultants engaged under this agreement.
Two presentation renderings at the end of schematic design.
Code review and permit set preparation for the local authority.
Changes to the approved program after design development sign-off are additional services.
LEED or other green building certification documentation.
Renderings or marketing materials beyond those listed in S5.
Interior furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E) selection and specification.
Existing-conditions surveys; the owner provides as-built drawings.

entries.note: Developed option A and option B massing for the addition.
Revised option B per client comments from the review meeting.
Two presentation renderings for SD sign-off.
Client asked to see a third layout option after SD sign-off, with the pharmacy moved to the ground floor.
DD client meeting #3, walls and finishes.
Coordinated roof framing with structural consultant.
DD meeting #7 with the hospital board, requested by client to review costs again.
Two extra renderings of the lobby for the client's fundraising brochure.
Client call about finishes.
Prepared LEED credit matrix and energy documentation the owner asked for.
Updated door hardware schedule.
CD kickoff with consultants.
Owner added an imaging suite on level 1. Re-planned level 1 and reworked plans A-101 to A-104.
Imaging suite: coordinated shielding and slab depression with structural and MEP.
Wall sections and details for the east elevation.
Code review for egress after the imaging suite change.
Selected waiting room furniture and exam room equipment per client request.
Site visit to check existing conditions at the connection to the old building.
CD meeting #3 with client.
Permit set: life safety plans.
Misc. revisions.
